text: When I arrived in Chiangmai on the first day, I twisted my ankle. I was reaommended to see the doctor here. The doctor is very kind and patient. l don't want to twist my ankle again, but I would like to recommend friends to come to the clinic if needed.

restaurant_name: หมอเดชวัศวร์คลินิก เฉพาะทางด้านเวชกรรม กระดูกและข้อ
text:
The doctor was kind and very attentive to the patient. He asked about symptoms very comprehensively. The assistant was also lovely and polite.
The welcome was excellent, I was very impressed, and the price was also affordable.
author_name: อุทุมพร แก้วกัน

restaurant_name: หมอเดชวัศวร์คลินิก เฉพาะทางด้านเวชกรรม กระดูกและข้อ
text: The doctor was very helpful, spoke kindly and was friendly. They provided good advice and guidance in planning my treatment. The front desk assistant was also very friendly and polite. I went in the late morning with tendon pain, had a magnetic therapy session, and received medication in the evening. My condition improved significantly; before, walking was very painful, but now it's only slightly painful. I think I'll be able to work fully tomorrow.
